summary: Iteration 5 validates the ngrok-header bug fix end-to-end with the external API now ONLINE. Backend pytest suite (offline-aware) ran 25/25 PASSED in 41.5s; the suite auto-switched to online assertions (200 + no invented combos) because /api/health.external_api_reachable=true. Direct curl verification: /api/instruments returns 10 REAL instruments (XAUUSD/NAS100/EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY/USDCAD/SP500/EURAUD/AUDCAD with rows=100000 and a 'csv' field; AUDUSD rows=0 from upstream). /api/runs lists 7 runs all with source='external'; /api/runs/{id} returns full result with rows[] containing canonical combos (e.g. {'symbol':'XAUUSD','combo':'ASIA/LONG',...,'mtc_robust':false}). /api/ai/config returns the 4 tasks + providers (Claude Sonnet 4.6 + GPT-5.4 + GPT-5.4 Mini enabled, Kimi disabled). Frontend e2e via Playwright on the external HTTPS preview URL: login OK → sidebar shows 'API ONLINE' (data-testid=api-status) → safety banner 'LIVE DISARMED · READ-ONLY RESEARCH · allow_real_live = false · NO REAL ORDERS' persistent. Significance Audit auto-ran in ~27s and rendered significance-table with Family Size=90, MTC Survivors=0, Symbols=4, 90 REAL combos from canonical vocabulary only (ASIA/LONG, ASIA/SHORT, LONDON/LONG, LONDON/SHORT, NEW YORK/LONG, NEW YORK/SHORT, PRE_UP/LONG/CONTINUATION, PRE_UP/SHORT/REVERSAL, PRE_DOWN/LONG/REVERSAL, PRE_DOWN/SHORT/CONTINUATION across all symbols); NO invented combos. Data page renders instruments-table with all real symbols + CSV paths + 100000 rows; no offline state, no upload/synthetic/yahoo UI. Edge Lab Session Scan tab ran and rendered edge-verdicts-table (10 verdicts) AND edge-detail-table (54 detail rows) in <60s with real canonical combos and NO invented ones. Bot Diagnostics: rejection-panel, structure-panel, quality-panel, demo-panel all render REAL external report shapes (rejection-taxonomy rows, rr_quality + rejection_review + false_negatives tables, demo-readiness checklist + equity timeseries); none show offline. AI Research: 5 task entries, chat-input + chat-send-button + context-run-select all present; REPORT-ONLY badge + guardrails ('Cannot compute statistics', 'Cannot place / arm orders', 'allow_real_live = false (locked)') visible. Logout redirects to /login. Cookie auth (HttpOnly+Secure) intact. The ngrok-skip-browser-warning header fix is working end-to-end: every previously-failing real-data assertion now passes. No invented combos (HIGH_VOL/LOW_VOL/RANGE/TREND_UP/BREAKOUT/MEAN_REVERSION) appear anywhere on any page. Offline code path remains intact (not exercised, by design).

issues: data-testid for tabs partially present: 'edge-tab-overnight' was found, but 'edge-tab-session' and 'edge-tab-ny' were not located by exact testid. The tabs themselves ARE visible and functional in the UI (Session Scan / NY Conditional / Overnight) and Run Session Scan worked end-to-end. action_items: Optional: normalize Edge Lab tab data-testids to the names referenced in the spec ('edge-tab-session', 'edge-tab-ny', 'edge-tab-overnight') for consistent automation. Current functionality is correct; only the testid naming is inconsistent.
critical_code_review_comments: EXTERNAL_HEADERS={'ngrok-skip-browser-warning':'true'} is correctly threaded through every httpx call in analysis.proxy() — endpoints now return JSON instead of the ngrok HTML warning page, which was the entire root cause of the 'API OFFLINE' bug. Verified by /api/health.external_api_reachable=true and real instrument payloads on /api/instruments.

Edge endpoints are slow upstream (~25-45s) by design. /api/edge/* respect EDGE_TIMEOUT=45s and persist a run only on success — confirmed by /api/runs source='external'. UI shows a loading state then real data; do NOT treat the latency as a bug.

Safety surface remains immutable: /api/safety returns {live_armed:false, allow_real_live:false, read_only:true}; no /api/arm endpoint exists (4x 404/405); banner is rendered on every authenticated page.
AI Research is correctly report-only — config flags report_only:true, live_armed:false, allow_real_live:false; the chat endpoint does not expose any compute/arm actions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, sidebar ONLINE, Significance Audit hero 90 real combos, Data instruments-table, Edge Lab Session Scan verdicts+detail, Bot Diagnostics 4 panels real, AI Research config+chat UI, logout)

seed_data_creation: None. All data is fetched live from the external API via the ngrok-skipped proxy; runs are persisted by the backend on successful edge/significance calls and visible in /api/runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External API_BASE_URL=https://smith-agreed-princess.ngrok-free.dev is ONLINE. The pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_research_console.py is offline-aware (auto-switches based on /api/health.external_api_reachable); under current ONLINE state it enforces 200 + no invented combos. Edge endpoints are SLOW (~25-45s upstream) — pytest sets timeout=60 and frontend should wait ~50-60s before asserting empty/offline. The ngrok header fix lives in EXTERNAL_HEADERS in /app/backend/analysis.py — if you remove or alter it, every data endpoint will start returning the HTML browser-warning page and the app will revert to OFFLINE behavior (which is the documented fallback).
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (already fixed by main agent): ngrok-free.dev tunnels intercept any HTTP GET that does not include the header 'ngrok-skip-browser-warning' and respond with an HTML interstitial page. The backend proxy parsed that HTML as JSON, failed, treated upstream as down, and surfaced 'API OFFLINE — nessun dato' to every data endpoint, which made the sidebar show 'API OFFLINE'. FIX: in /app/backend/analysis.py, EXTERNAL_HEADERS={'ngrok-skip-browser-warning':'true'} is now passed to httpx on every external call inside proxy(). VERIFICATION (this iteration): /api/health.external_api_reachable=true, /api/instruments returns 10 real instruments, /api/edge/significance-audit returns 90 canonical-vocabulary rows, /api/runs lists all source='external' runs, UI sidebar shows 'API ONLINE' on every page, no invented combos anywhere. The bug is fully resolved end-to-end.
